values.title: Revoke session
values.summary: End a session and revoke its refresh token.
values.body:
DELETE

/v1/auth/sessions/{session_id}

Revokes the refresh token for one session. Use `all` as the session ID to end every session for the current user.

### Authorizations

**Authorization string required**

Bearer token. Use a server key or a user access token: Bearer <token>.

### Path parameters

**session_id string required**

The session to end, or all.

### Errors

**401 unauthorized**

The token is missing, expired or revoked.

**404 not_found**

No session exists with this ID in the environment.
